The gap between neoprene and Viton
Nitrile and neoprene stop at +120 °C. FKM reaches +250 °C and costs two to three times more. AEM covers the 120–160 °C band that most underhood parts actually sit in.
Heat and oil, not heat alone
EPDM handles the temperature and swells in mineral oil. AEM resists hot oil, ATF and glycol as well as heat — which is the combination an engine bay actually presents.
A bush that takes a set works loose in its housing and starts fretting. AEM holds its shape hot — and we test compression set to ASTM D395 Method B in-house.
It is one of the eight compounds we mix in-house, not a bought-in blend. Few Indian moulders carry it at all — which is usually why a bush like this gets over-specified to FKM.

Compound datasheets and dimensioned drawings are issued per part on request, under NDA where required. For AEM we can supply heat-ageing and fluid-immersion data against your service condition — tell us the temperature and the medium.
What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted against the part where geometry or tooling makes that unrealistic. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send the sample or the drawing and we will produce a dimensioned drawing and confirm compound before tooling. If the sample has hardened in service, tell us — a bush that has aged has also shrunk, and we dimension to the original, not to the aged part.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?
PDF, DWG, DXF and STEP. A dimensioned 2D drawing with tolerances is enough to quote; a 3D model helps with tooling. If you only have a sample, send the sample — we will produce the drawing.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house. For AEM we can also report heat-ageing and fluid-immersion results against your service condition.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?
TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment.
